*Note: Metformin, used for type 2 diabetes, is a prescription drug which has been used by physicians as an “off-label” treatment of obesity. Historically, health care providers have 
had some leverage in how they may prescribe drugs approved by the FDA. For example, in treating obesity, a qualifited health care provider may prescribe a drug approved for treat-
ing another medical problem, prescribe two or more drugs at the same time, and/or prescribe a drug for a longer period of time than approved by the FDA.
